Challenge: Interplanetary Survival Guide: Martian Map
About Us: We are a complete, multidisciplinary team tackling the Martian Map challenge for the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge. Bringing together skills in full-stack development, geospatial data visualization, UI/UX design, and planetary science research, we are excited to combine open NASA datasets to build practical tools that support human exploration in The Next Frontier.
